fields.Name: IT88 - User Privilege Elevation Guard
fields.Description: Issue #4260 on the real stack: ClassFactory resolves MJUserEntityServer for MJ: Users and the provider builds it (UE1), a non-Owner changing User.Type is refused by the guard's Validate() with the error attributed to Type (UE2), an Owner may still change Type so the admin path stays open (UE3), and — where a non-Owner principal actually holds CanUpdate on MJ: Users — a real Save() of a Type change does not succeed, attempted inside an always-rolled-back transaction (UE4). The guard's branch logic is unit-covered in MJCoreEntitiesServer; this bundle proves the wiring. Server transport; no fixtures created and nothing persisted.
